title: Busbar section (asset overlay)
description: Phase 5a asset overlay kind. One section of a substation busbar. It collapses to an existing authored bus (the bus ref): several sections may name the same bus when the authored model does not split them. Carried beside the model, never used by the solver.

label.description: The section label on the single-line diagram (for example Main 1 section A).

bus.description: The authored bus this section collapses to.
